label: Jesus founded at least one society satisfying the selected Church…, by Founding through a multiply…
rule: Founding through a multiply attested governing power
meaning: A route that needs no whole report to go back to Jesus: John 20's commission is independent of Matthew 18's or 16's, and by the attestation criterion Jesus gave some heaven-ratified power, which is governing; the founding and Church-calibration premises then give a selected Church founded by Jesus. Each of the four premises is needed.
